Schnittstelle Receiver<A>

Typparameter:
A - the type of accepted input values
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Applicable<A,Nothing>, Consumer<A>, Fun<A,Nothing>, Function<A,Nothing>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Receiver<A> extends Fun<A,Nothing>, Consumer<A>

A Receiver is an enhanced Consumer that processes input values and exposes a functional interface suitable for combinator-style operations.

This interface augments standard consumer behaviour with optional filtering via a Predicate before values are accepted. It also implements Fun for seamless integration with functional APIs.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null. Implementations should reject null values and must not produce null results where applicable.

  • Methodendetails

    • receiver

      static <A> Receiver<A> receiver(@NonNull Consumer<A> consumer)

      Creates a new Receiver that delegates to the given Consumer without filtering.

      Contract: consumer must not be null; accepted values must not be null.

      Typparameter:
      A - the input value type
      Parameter:
      consumer - the consumer to delegate to; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a new Receiver wrapping the given consumer
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if consumer is null

    • receiver

      static <A> Receiver<A> receiver(@NonNull Consumer<A> consumer, @NonNull Predicate<A> filter)

      Creates a new Receiver that delegates to the given Consumer and filters incoming values using the provided Predicate.

      Contract: consumer and filter must not be null; accepted values must not be null.

      Typparameter:
      A - the input value type
      Parameter:
      consumer - the consumer that processes accepted values; must not be null
      filter - the acceptance condition; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a new Receiver encapsulating the given logic
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if consumer or filter is null

    • receiver

      static <A> Receiver<A> receiver(@NonNull Consumer<A> consumer, @NonNull Predicate<A> filter, @NonNull Function<? super A, ? extends RuntimeException> exceptionBuilder)

      Creates a new Receiver that delegates to the given Consumer, filters values with Predicate, and throws an exception built by exceptionBuilder for rejected values.

      Contract: consumer, filter, and exceptionBuilder must not be null. The exceptionBuilder must not return null. Accepted values must not be null.

      Typparameter:
      A - the input value type
      Parameter:
      consumer - the consumer processing accepted values; must not be null
      filter - the acceptance condition; must not be null
      exceptionBuilder - builds the exception for rejected values; must not be null and must not return null
      Gibt zurück:
      a new Receiver encapsulating the given logic
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any parameter is null or if exceptionBuilder returns null

    • apply

      default @NonNull Nothing apply(@NonNull A value)

      default Receiver<A> acceptAllAndContinue(@NonNull A first, @NonNull A... others)
